name: ANSI/IEEE Resistor with disconnecting slider form
aliases: IEEE Resistor with Mobile Contact and Disconnecting Position
summary: IEEE-library form of resistor with disconnecting slider: this form distinguishes a movable resistor contact with a disconnecting position.
description: This reference locates resistor with disconnecting slider in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented resistive components family. This form distinguishes a movable resistor contact with a disconnecting position. The movable contact can leave the resistive track at its documented disconnecting position. This changes circuit continuity as well as the selected resistance. The public library uses HVR1R5 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Follow the actual current path and terminal polarity in the surrounding circuit. The symbol identifies an electrical function; voltage, current, energy limits and the device package pinout come from the selected component data rather than from the outline.

Show the track ends, slider terminal and the off-position relationship. A generic potentiometer or variable-resistor graphic can omit this important additional operating state. Show the track terminals, movable contact and the circuit condition at the off position. A disconnecting slider is different from a continuously connected potentiometer wiper. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
